parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE status = 'created') AS open_tasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE status = 'claimed') AS in_progress, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE status = 'completed' AND "updatedAt"::date = CURRENT_DATE) AS completed_today, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(reward), 0) FROM tasks WHERE status = 'created') AS total_reward_pool, (SELECT json_agg(t ORDER BY CASE t.urgency WHEN 'high' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) FROM (SELECT "shortDescription", reward, urgency, city, status FROM tasks WHERE status IN ('created', 'claimed') AND ("expiresAt" IS NULL OR "expiresAt" > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) LIMIT 10) t) AS active_tasks;
